id.description: Must equal the folder name. Lowercase kebab-case, starts and ends with a letter or digit.

kind.description: custom: we wrote it. wrapped: launches a pinned upstream package. relay: a thin front for a daemon or remote service.

entry.description: Module to run, relative to the service folder. Omit to serve tools/ with the standard service runtime.

instructions.description: Short server instructions the harness puts in the model's prompt. Long usage goes in GUIDE.md.

toolPrefix.description: Prefix every tool name carries, e.g. "zdr_". Also names the standard tools (<prefix>guide).

profiles.description: Instances of this service. Registered as <id>-<profile>; "default" registers as <id>.

services.description: Background daemons this service needs; the installer generates LaunchAgents from these.

requires.description: Things that must exist first: mcp:<id>, app:<name>, vpn:<name>, file:<path>.

test.description: Command that runs this service's tests from its folder.

launcher.description: Executable start script relative to the service folder, for starts that need more than declared env (a clean environment, a secret broker, a credential check). bin/run execs it with MCP_ID, MCP_PROFILE, MCP_DIR and MCP_REPO set and the profile name as $1. Lives in src/.

cli.description: Human CLI names this service provides from bin/, linked onto PATH by the installer.

env.description: Environment keys and where to read them. Names and sources only, never values.

source.description: dotfiles-env (repo .env), file:<path> (~, ${repo}, ${service} expand), or process (inherited environment).

harnesses.description: Where to register this service. A key present means registered; its object holds per-harness settings.
